conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: You guys are ripping me off! My loan statement shows a late fee, but I paid on time!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I’m sorry you’re upset, sir. Can you share your loan account number to verify the payment?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: It’s 789456123. I paid ₹20,000 on the 5th! This is a scam!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Thank you. I see the payment, but it was credited a day late due to an ECS mandate issue. I’ll waive the fee.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: You better! I’m not paying for your mistakes!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: The fee is waived, sir. You’ll see the updated statement in 24 hours. I apologize for the trouble.
